dct_description_sm: "Drawn by R.K. Sneden, 40th NY, Hdqs. 3rd Corps, from plan furnished by Genl. D. B. Birney"--lower right.
Available also through the Library of Congress web site as a raster image.
Color coding indicates the location of Union and Confederate forces.
Contributors: Birney, David Bell, 1825-1864.; Sneden, Robert Knox, 1832-1918.
In the Robert Knox Sneden Scrapbook (Mss5:7 Sn237:1 p. 283).
Map attempts to show the locations of various units during each day of the battle. All major landmarks are indicated.
NOTE: Researchers will be served a color photocopy of this scrapbook image.
This item is from the collections of the Virginia Historical Society; please contact the institution for more information.
dct_title_s: Copy of official plan of Gettysburg. Pennsylvania, fought 1st, 2nd, 3rd July 1863.
